credits_text: Starring Miriam Consoles, Pablo Martinez, Yolanda de la Hoz and Celia Arias. Directed by Cristina Garcia Lorente. Produced by Andrea Laura Larra. Sound: Angela Mihat Petru. Art director: Andrea Laura Larra. Assistant director: Cobetri Eirro. Poster illustration: Nereida Marin.
other_text: Horror is a warm, sunny day.
description: A vintage-style poster features a plant with purple flowers and green leaves, overlaid with the title 'MENHIR' in large, translucent letters.
